class.name: Bloodmoon Vampire Class
lore: Choose the Bloodmoon Vampire Class
class.name_es: Vampiro de la Luna de Sangre
class.role_es: Guerrero · sangre y robo de vida
class.desc_es: Un vampiro que moldea su sangre en cuatro armas (Hojas, Grimorio, Agujas y Guadaña), cada una con sus combos, y roba la vida de sus enemigos.

skills.name: Bloodbending
lore: Bloodbend into 4 different types of weapon forms.
Available forms are Blades, Grimoire, Needles, and Scythe.
skills.desc_es: Pasiva: moldeas tu sangre en una de cuatro armas: Hojas, Grimorio, Agujas o Guadaña.

skills.name: Bloodmoon Combo
lore: Crimson Slash (Blades): Execute a 3 step combo. Lash out an X slash -
Rapid thrust - Dash back and forth, thrust and slash sideways
Bloodspike Arcanum (Grimoire): Execute a 3 step combo. Summon a series of blood spikes
- Repeat - Summon a blood orb meteor that falls towards the
location you're looking at, creating a blood spike rupture
that damages enemies inside.
Scarlet Quills (Needles): Fire blood needles that stack onto the enemy (Max 5).
Reaper`s Spiral (Scythe): Execute a 4 step combo. Dash forwards with a spinning slash,
knocking back enemies - Repeat - Dash upwards with a spinning slash,
knocking up enemies - Dash downwards with a spinning slash,
knocking down enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {bladescooldown}s Cooldown (Blades)
⌛ {grimoirecooldown}s Cooldown (Grimoire)
⌛ {needlescooldown}s Cooldown (Needles)
⌛ {scythecooldown}s Cooldown (Scythe)
skills.desc_es: Un combo distinto según tu arma: cortes en X con las Hojas, púas y meteoro con el Grimorio, agujas que se acumulan o tajos amplios con la Guadaña.

skills.name: Vampiric Surge
lore: Vampiric Dash (Blades): Perform an explosive dash, slashing through all
enemies and draining their health.
Bat Swarm (Grimoire): Fire blood bats, draining the health of all hit enemies.
Bloodburst (Needles): Explode all stacked needles on nearby enemies,
more needles dealing more damage and draining more health.
Soul Harvester (Scythe): Throw your spinning blood scythe, knocking back
and draining the health of hit enemies. Your thrown blood scythe
slows down and comes back to you, this time pulling enemies in.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🗡 {heal} Life Dragin
⌛ {bladescooldown}s Cooldown (Blades)
⌛ {grimoirecooldown}s Cooldown (Grimoire)
⌛ {needlescooldown}s Cooldown (Needles)
⌛ {scythecooldown}s Cooldown (Scythe)
skills.desc_es: Según tu arma: embestida que roba vida, murciélagos de sangre, explosión de agujas o guadaña giratoria; todas te curan.

skills.name: Bloodborne Blades
lore: Bloodbend into Blades form. The Blades are fast, multi-striking,
short radius weapons. You gain speed I while in Blades form.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Tu sangre toma forma de hojas: rápidas, de varios golpes y corto alcance. Ganas velocidad.

skills.name: Bloodborne Needles
lore: Bloodbend into Needles form. Needles are fast, long ranged weapons.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Tu sangre toma forma de agujas: rápidas y de largo alcance.

skills.name: Bloodborne Grimoire
lore: Bloodbend into Grimoire form. The Grimoire is a normal speed,
long ranged, AOE focused weapon.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Tu sangre toma forma de grimorio: velocidad normal, largo alcance y daño en área.

skills.name: Bloodborne Scythe
lore: Bloodbend into Scythe form. The Scythe is a slow, heavy, big
radius weapon. You gain slowness I while in Blades form.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Tu sangre toma forma de guadaña: lenta, pesada y de gran alcance. Vas un poco más lento.
